## Round 1 · scenario half · round record 2026-11-09T23:47Z

Not a `qa-run` record (a scenario run is not a checklist selector; `lanes/qa.md` 〈每轮〉). Subject `0647dabb06ee314981b25fcc5a15de304de42c9d`, the six `starter` cards of `docs/qa/scenarios`, `run-scenarios --modes scratch --packages workspace` (76 packages packed, `packages: workspace @ 0647dabb (unreleased)`). Runner `session_01QsR2jT2gdWkjebLaZAv7qz`: subscription `oauth_token` login, no API variables, Accept-edits mode; claude-code-cli 2.1.319; every turn served claude-opus-5-5. All six exited 0; no headless `claude -p` was refused.

| card | Build | Seed | Run 问数 | Run ops | Iterate Build | Iterate 问数 | Iterate ops | wall |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| asset_lifecycle | 141/141 | 559/559 | 11/15 | 3/6 | 152/152 | 12/15 | 4/6 | 58m51s |
| leave_balances | 116/116 | 617/617 | 12/15 | 4/6 | 131/131 | 11/15 | 3/6 | 45m03s |
| order_to_cash | 145/146 | 6/619 (613 refused) | 1/2 · 10 not measured | 0/0 · 6 not measured | 158/159 | 1/2 · 10 not measured | 0/0 · 6 not measured | 27m44s |
| requisition_to_receipt | 131/131 | 637/637 | 12/13 | 3/6 | 140/140 | 13/13 | 3/6 | 41m05s |
| service_desk | 122/124 | 496/496 | 13/16 | 2/6 | 128/130 | 14/16 | 4/6 | 41m53s |
| travel_expense | 111/111 | 757/757 | 12/13 | 4/6 | 122/122 | 13/13 | 1/6 | 39m43s |

Capability tags: every scored tag passes except `dashboards.report` on service_desk (the authoring agent built no report). Unscored by design: `ai.ask-data`, plus a few automation and atomic-save tags.

**Every failing check, classified** (P platform · A authoring/answering agent · R runner or card), from the runner's per-turn reading of the records:

- P (security): 6 turns across asset_lifecycle, order_to_cash, service_desk, travel_expense · security finding — detail withheld, reported to PM.
- P: service_desk build: a field the platform's reserved-word rule refuses on an object passes when declared through an object extension → extracted below.
- R (card): order_to_cash and service_desk require a field the platform reserves (ADR-0090 D3), so order_to_cash's seed was refused 613/619 and its run is almost entirely unmeasured.
- R (scorer and observer): decline and correction phrase lists too narrow (at least 7 correct declines failed); a flow's declared refusal read as applied; date parts and unrelated numbers read as leaks; "who" questions graded on a count figure; an average with zero tolerance; the build select check does not read object extensions; direct-CRUD probes scored as platform failures where the build routes the write through an action → one card for the scenarios package, extracted below.
- A: `confirm_irreversible` failed in all 5 measured cards: the agent sent `confirm: true` on its first call, taking the request as consent. The platform lists `requiresConfirmation` and behaves to its contract; whether the product wants a human round-trip is a product question, reported to the maintainer, not carded.
- A: builds that left a step's approver empty, a flow that is not transactional (ADR-0077 documents why), one missing report, agents answering a substitute question instead of declining.
- Unconfirmed lead, not carded: an authoring summary says an analytics dimension on a field named `group` broke; no error output in the transcript.

Cost: setup 3 min plus the first workspace pack 11 min; whole round about 2h23m (07:57–10:21Z), three pairs. Subscription quota, not API-billed; the CLI's API-equivalent figure summed from the records is about $114 (authoring about $64 of it). The report reached the seat on 2026-11-09 only: the runner's `send_message` waited on a permission prompt in Accept-edits mode for about 37 h, until the maintainer approved it.
